en: The image depicts an old railway station building with a steam locomotive on the left and several people, including women and children, standing and walking outside. The building is set against a rural landscape with a castle visible on a distant hill. The postcard has colorized elements and a clean, historical appearance. There is German text at the top, and the setting features benches and a cart, suggesting early 20th-century European rural life.
